resources.string: Unofficial fork built on top of Mochy Music by realidkroo

Mochy Ext is a free, open-source community fork built on Mochy Music (GPL-3.0). It installs alongside official Mochy and adds unified wallpaper-matched theming, a self-hosted community Module Store with creator-approval removal, Google Drive cloud backups, and stability improvements for 4 GB RAM devices. Please report Mochy Ext issues on Rizky088/Mochy-Music-Custom rather than official Mochy channels.
